clips.title: The story
paras: In Orgrimmar, Rilli Greasygob seeks the scattered pages of the Samophlange Manual. The handbook holds instructions for repairing and operating the Venture Company's samophlange.

Boss Copperplug guarded the Venture Company's knowledge of the samophlange. The ambitious overseer kept the manual's pages from most workers, giving scattered leaves only to his most loyal subordinates. When the device slipped from company hands, no one could repair it without gathering the torn documentation from Copperplug and his crew at the Boulder Lode Mine.

Rilli Greasygob left the Venture Company and settled in Orgrimmar to learn how the samophlange was built. Copperplug had never favored him, so Rilli depends on enterprising travelers to retrieve the manual's cover and loose leaves. Reassembled, the handbook gives goblin tinkerers working alongside the Horde a rare look at Venture Company engineering.
